name: InfluxDB
description: Store metrics, sensor readings and events from your NAS, Home Assistant and other devices in a time-series database that lives on the NAS. InfluxDB 2.10 keeps buckets, dashboards, tasks and alerts, and answers Flux and InfluxQL queries; the web UI opens in its own EthOS window on port 8086, where the first visit creates the administrator, organisation, bucket and API token. Data lives in a package volume that survives updates.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: resource guard — 2 GB memory, 1.5 CPUs, 256 processes and 10 MB × 3 rotated logs so InfluxDB cannot starve or fill the NAS. 1.0.0: first release — InfluxDB OSS 2.10.1 pinned, data and config in volumes that survive updates, the web UI and API on port 8086 (own login on the first visit) and a container healthcheck.
